detail: a tiered wooden scriptorium where apprentice surveyors record fleeting rumors into rough field notebooks, journeymen cross-check bearings across observation ledgers, and master cartographers engrave verified landmarks into permanent copper plates with steel styluses under gas lamps

evidence.quote: Knowledge maturity ladder: DATA -> FIELD NOTES / OBSERVATIONS -> INSIGHTS -> CANON. Canon diffs should read as addition. Promotion is explicit: harvest / notice -> fold in own words -> curate.

facts.scale_ref: clerks and surveyors on rolling brass ladders navigating four ascending gallery levels of maturity
facts.material: polished dark oak desks, aged rag paper, brass sighting instruments, heavy iron-bound registry volumes
facts.state: quiet, methodical scratching of quills and steady smell of lamp oil and gall ink

note: The four-tier epistemic ladder where raw observations mature over years into unalterable canon. Demoting an established entry requires an official inquest and public revocation.
